meta.note: Eligibility text here is general guidance only. Fees, cutoffs, deadlines and scholarship slabs are deliberately NOT stored as numbers. Confirm every figure on admission.lpu.in before publishing this site.

university.name: Lovely Professional University (LPU)
university.campus: A large single-campus university on the Jalandhar-Delhi GT Road, with academic blocks, hostels, sports grounds, a shopping area and its own transport network.

programmes.name: B.Tech
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (some specialisations accept Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Computer Science). Selection is through LPUNEST or a qualifying national entrance score, followed by counselling.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST / JEE Main / other accepted national tests

programmes.name: BCA
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream, usually with Mathematics or Computer Science preferred for some specialisations.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: BBA
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream from a recognised board.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: B.Com
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream, Commerce preferred.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: B.Sc
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in the science stream with the subjects required by the chosen specialisation.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: BA
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream from a recognised board.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: B.Des
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream. A design aptitude test or portfolio may be part of the process for some specialisations.

programmes.name: B.Pharm
programmes.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Chemistry, plus either Biology or Mathematics.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or a qualifying national pharmacy entrance score

programmes.name: LLB
programmes.eligibility: A bachelor's degree in any discipline. Integrated five-year law programmes are also offered after Class 12.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or CLAT / other accepted law entrance scores

programmes.name: MBA
programmes.eligibility: A bachelor's degree in any discipline. Selection considers LPUNEST or a national management entrance score, plus group discussion and interview for some specialisations.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST / CAT / MAT / CMAT / other accepted tests

programmes.name: MCA
programmes.eligibility: A bachelor's degree, typically with Mathematics at Class 12 or graduation level depending on the specialisation.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: M.Tech
programmes.eligibility: A B.Tech or B.E. in a relevant discipline. GATE scores are considered for some specialisations.

programmes.name: M.Sc
programmes.eligibility: A B.Sc or equivalent degree in the relevant subject.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: MA
programmes.eligibility: A bachelor's degree in a relevant or related discipline.
programmes.entrance: LPUNEST or direct admission subject to eligibility

programmes.name: PhD
programmes.eligibility: A master's degree in a relevant discipline with the minimum marks set by the university, followed by an entrance test and interview.
programmes.entrance: LPU doctoral entrance test and interview

programmes.name: Diploma programmes
programmes.eligibility: Class 10 or Class 12 depending on the diploma. Lateral entry routes exist for some programmes.

admission_steps: Open the official admission portal at admission.lpu.in.
Register as a new applicant with your email and mobile number.
Complete the application form with your personal and academic details.
Select the programme and specialisation you want.
Check the eligibility criteria for that specific programme.
Complete the entrance requirement: LPUNEST, or a qualifying national test where the programme accepts one.
Upload or submit the required documents.
Check your scholarship eligibility against the current official criteria.
Follow the university's instructions for fee payment. Pay only through the official portal.
Track your admission status on the portal and respond to any counselling communication.

scholarships.name: Academic merit
scholarships.detail: Based on Class 12 or qualifying examination marks, on a slab system. The slabs change by session.

scholarships.name: LPUNEST based
scholarships.detail: Based on your LPUNEST score, with higher scores attracting larger concessions.

scholarships.name: National level examinations
scholarships.detail: Consideration for students with strong JEE Main, NEET, CAT, MAT, CLAT or similar scores, where the programme accepts them.

scholarships.name: Sports
scholarships.detail: For students with a recognised record at state, national or international level. Trials or certificates are usually required.

scholarships.name: Cultural
scholarships.detail: For achievement in performing or creative arts, usually assessed through an audition or portfolio.

scholarships.name: Financial assistance
scholarships.detail: Support for specific categories and circumstances as defined in the current official policy, including defence personnel and sibling concessions where offered.

hostel: Separate hostels for men and women, with air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned room options.
Mess facilities with multiple menus, plus food courts and cafes across campus.
Wi-Fi, laundry, medical support and campus-wide security.
University transport connecting the campus to nearby towns.
Sports facilities including grounds, courts and a gym, with clubs and cultural societies.

faqs.a: Register on admission.lpu.in, complete the form, choose your programme, and follow the portal's instructions for documents and fees.
It depends on the programme. Many programmes accept LPUNEST or a national entrance score, and some allow direct admission subject to eligibility. Check the specific programme page.

faqs.q: Can I get admission without an entrance exam?
faqs.a: For several programmes, yes, subject to eligibility. Competitive programmes generally weigh an entrance score.
Lateral entry routes exist for some diploma and degree programmes. Confirm the current rules for your programme on the official portal.

faqs.q: How do I check my application status?
faqs.a: Only the official admission portal can show your status. This assistant cannot access or verify applications.
